package_type: Targeted A-only timing repair on the b19 A candidate: one register stage in the a1_frame_top abort->smem read-address cone, cycle-neutral for normal frames; full sim regression; 1 Routed (0 viol, WNS >= +0.05), 1 bitgen + 1 CWC; 1 SRAM download, R14 reset alignment, COM8 300 s.

decision_basis.b19_result: A chain sim all PASS; synthesis +0.127; routed -0.098 ns / 10 violated endpoints, all clk_a1 self; worst u_a1/a1_abort_reg -> u_a1/u_a1/smem.addrb[10] (6 levels, ERAM); no bit/CWC/download; gate correctly stopped.
decision_basis.why_b20: the only failing structure is one abort-launched cone in a1_frame_top; the user approved one targeted repair attempt on A.
decision_basis.chosen: baseline = b19 r0 changed-src byte-identical except a1_frame_top.v (one pipeline stage in the abort->smem address path); SDC 0888b6a7... and ADC 1cb30346... byte-identical; PAXI x8/mask=0/retry/R1/v6 unchanged.
rejected: re-route b19 with another seed/effort (route budget spent; not a repair)
relax SDC / add false path / multicycle / change clock or frequency
add a pipeline in the normal drain data path (would change cycles/CRC timing)
touch a1_deflate_core.v, camera_a1_uart_top.v, the top, PAXI, retry or v6 code
reuse the b18 bit/CWC (B camera) or claim b19 evidence as b20 PASS
a second download or second capture after a no-pixel A result

gates.diff: 10 of 11 changed-src hash-equal to b19; SDC 0888B6A7... and ADC 1CB30346... hash-equal; a1_frame_top.v only
gates.merge: C01-C18 pass; C19 SDC byte-identical to b19; C20 frozen-anchor equality on the listed a1_frame_top anchors + no new port/ifdef/force; C17 A-branch pairs=17 diffs=0; C18' sysstat=0x00000F1D bit12=0
gates.sim: T1 exact b19 counters incl cycles=37,465,298 / cmp_words=648,677 / cmp_writes=81,085 / read_words=129,600 / dup=0 / exp_bytes=2,594,706 / four CRC+zlib; T2 native 5/5; T3 P1 three goldens byte-identical; T4 timeout=1 retry=1 giveup=0 exported=1/3 cycles +0..+16; T5 v6 273/6/67 f13=00000f01 bit12=0; T6 sysstat=00000f1d a_selected=1 b_selected=0; vlog Errors:0
gates.synth: <=2 attempts, SWNS >= 0, STNS >= 0, 0 violations, ERAM + CWC <= 300
gates.route_precondition: synth SWNS >= +0.127 (b19 synth value); below -> FAIL(synth_no_gain), no route, no bitgen
gates.route: <=1 attempt, 0 violated endpoints, hold >= 0, period > 0; WNS >= +0.05 target; +0.003..<+0.05 = thin-margin caveat candidate (may go to bitgen/board with caveat); < +0.003 or any violation -> FAIL, no bitgen
gates.per_group: clk_a1 >= +0.05; ddr_user >= +0.003; mipi_a_byte_clk >= +0.05; sys_clk50m >= +1.0; pclkx1 >= +0.5; any other violated group = FAIL
gates.cone_break: 0 routed paths launched by a1_abort_reg into smem.addrb[*]; quote the new worst clk_a1 path; slices <= 25,800; ERAM <= 103; DSP 0; GCLK 9
gates.bit: 1 bitgen + 1 CWC; fail-closed SETUP/HOLD/PERIOD; bit/CWC/BID sha256; cw/compiled.bit|.cwc byte-identical; <phy_eram> present, no incomplete <logic_eram/>
gates.board: preflight FTDI 0403:6042 + COM8 with COM8 closed; 1 SRAM download of the b20 bit first; then read R14 reset_pulse and timestamps; then COM8 300 s; bit12=0 bit20=0; v6 273/6/67 bad_xor=0; A pix_beats>0 line_rises>0 frame_rises>0; enc>0 exported>0; >=1 FRAME four CRCs+zlib; no full-payload bad CRC (tail-cut allowed); raw_drop/raw_abort not growing; timeout/retry/giveup not growing
gates.board_no_pixels: if A pix/line/frame all 0: keep 300 s capture + status_v6 + cam_* + phystat + sysstat + lane_sticky; board=blocked_A_no_pixels; A front-end/hardware conclusion; no rebuild, no second download/capture
gates.board_operator: reset_pulse not possible -> still capture 300 s, mark missing frame ambiguous -> board=blocked_operator; no claim that A is dead
gates.board_giveup: if giveup grows: keep timeout_ar_addr/low3 + last_issued_ar_addr + diag_flags + inflight_state; stop; no second bitstream/capture/Flash

hardware.preflight: Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly match VID_0403&PID_6042 and HKLM SERIALCOMM COM8; absent/busy -> board=blocked, 0 downloads, 0 COM8
hardware.order: FTDI preflight -> 1 SRAM download with COM8 closed -> verify B20_DL_OK -> close hwserver/JTAG -> operator pulses R14 -> wait 2 s -> open COM8 300 s
hardware.reset_alignment: one R14 (sys_rst_n) pulse after download and before COM8; log reset_pulse=yes/no, download time, capture-start time
hardware.capture: 300 s at 115200 8N1 (worst-case stored frame 2,594,706 B = 225.2 s); outdir r0/board/captures_a
hardware.release: close COM8 before any further JTAG; no second download; no re-capture
hardware.negative_control: check_b20_board.py must FAIL the b18 B capture (camsel_bit12=1) before any download

path_contract.td: T: = T10.b20-a-timing/r0/td, Y: = D:\fpga\ph1p100; never map X: to the project root; run tools/td/td_env.ps1 first

stop_rule: conformance after 2 attempts; sim gate failure; synth gate failure or SWNS < +0.127; route violated or < +0.003; bitgen/CWC failure; board giveup growing; A no pixels; operator unavailable; budget exhausted -> stop and return to the original planner. No second route/download/capture, no Flash, no SDC/clock/seed change, no batch delete.
